name: Business Analyst AI Toolkit
description: Map requirements, write acceptance criteria, explore processes and validate data using accessible tools.

workflows.goal: Draft and review a BRD or PRD
workflows.example: Start from stakeholder notes, identify assumptions, then trace each acceptance criterion to a requirement.

workflows.goal: Prepare meeting minutes and source-backed summaries
workflows.example: Summarize approved meeting notes, separate decisions from open questions, and check every action against the transcript.

workflows.goal: Explore SQL, spreadsheets and KPI reports
workflows.example: Run a sample SQL query in a notebook and verify row counts before using the result in a dashboard.

workflows.goal: Outline stakeholder journeys and presentation decks
workflows.example: Turn an agreed process into a visual explanation and check every step with the process owner.

name: UI/UX & Figma Designer Toolkit
description: Research, sketch, prototype, evaluate accessibility and collaborate on product design.

workflows.example: Sketch a task flow, build low-fidelity screens and review them with representative users.

workflows.goal: Build visual assets and design critiques
workflows.example: Try a proposed layout and check hierarchy, legibility, contrast and keyboard behavior.

name: Website Builder Toolkit
description: Plan, generate, test and publish web experiences with practical free-tier and open-source options.

workflows.example: Create a mobile-first landing page, confirm copy and publish a preview before production.

workflows.goal: Review and refine a working website
workflows.example: Inspect generated code, test key forms and verify external links before promoting to production.

name: Web & App Builder Toolkit
description: Choose no-code, full-stack or local tools for building applications, integrations and prototypes.

workflows.example: Start with roles, data ownership and key user journeys before choosing the build tool.
Separate public and private credentials, enforce access controls and test failure/retry cases.
